target_customer: Developers and companies running AI agents (such as Claude Code) that need a human expert when an agent is stuck; experts are paid per session
problem: AI agents hit walls where they need real domain judgment, and there is no instant way to escalate to a verified human.
business_model: Two sided marketplace and usage-based API; volume pricing and invoicing for companies
product_category: Human expert marketplace for AI agents via MCP

founders.name: Yash Goenka
previous_startups: Built first LLM startup in 2021 (outcome not stated); two-time founder
founders.background_notes: AI engineer; holds a patent on graphene supercapacitor manufacturing per YC page. One third-party profile calls him CTO.

founders.name: Rohan Datta
previous_startups: AI voice calling platform that automated over 1 million minutes of calls

competitors.name: Tendem by Toloka
competitors.what: Human expert judgment callable by AI agents via MCP
competitors.traction_then: Claims over 10,000 verified experts across 20 plus specialties

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time matching, expert verification and an MCP server are standard engineering; reliability under 30 second latency and supply of experts are the harder parts.

defensibility.rationale: Expert supply and demand could create marketplace effects, but the interface is easy to copy and large data labeling firms hold expert networks.

market_need_then: Agent adoption surged by 2026 and coding agents regularly stall; the company reports 3,000 plus experts and an 83 percent resolution rate (self reported).

branding.community_and_virality: Launch coverage by several tech newsletters in April 2026; operating entity listed as Orange AI Inc.

brand_strength.rationale: Compound of human and work, close to Upwork in sound; a handful of launch articles but no wider brand evidence.

outcome_analysis: Humwork launched in April 2026 during YC Spring 2026 with a small team and no reported outcome yet. It is a new marketplace with open hiring, so no success or failure factors are asserted.
notes: Unverified funding: Startup Seeker and Orange AI profile list about 500K (seed, January 2026) from YC and YC founders; no press release, so no round recorded. Usage metrics are company claims. Source for competitor is a vendor blog.
